findings.title: ELF/binary-shape and self-authored version logs do not prove native Synopsys execution
findings.evidence: The complete accepted chain uses one /bin/true image for VCS, DC, Formality, PrimeTime, Memory Compiler and simv. Every alleged DB is /bin/true plus appended bytes. After changing only the fixture's stale M527 identity before generation, the forged manifest becomes validated_production_run_count=1.
findings.impact: A grammar fixture can be counted as a production run with invented 0.6 mm2 and 0.33 mW values.
findings.required_repair: Bind approved installed-tool executable identities and exact compiler DB inventory, capture actual raw version stdout and process exit from a trusted runner, and reject fixture/synthetic provenance at the production boundary. DBs need approved hashes or tool-read evidence, not NUL/UTF-8 heuristics.

findings.title: Execution-step executable is not coupled to argv[0] or the expected tool
findings.evidence: The DC step executable was replaced by a different /bin/false ELF while argv[0] remained the alleged dc_shell path and the two SHA256 values differed. Re-rooting the self-authored text log was sufficient for extraction to pass.
findings.impact: The receipt does not establish which binary executed the claimed command.
findings.required_repair: Require entry.executable path/SHA to equal argv[0] and the exact tool_run executable for every step; for vcs_run require exact produced simv identity. Derive the execution record from the runner rather than accepting a user-authored block.

findings.title: Ten-operator scope anchors admit behavioral stubs and an unmapped RTL copy as netlist
findings.evidence: All ten leaf modules contain only 'wire alive'; the alleged mapped netlist is byte-for-byte identical to that RTL. Module/instance name regexes still declare full-scope success.
findings.impact: A selected slice or empty shell can masquerade as the frozen full ten-operator H67 implementation.
findings.required_repair: Bind the frozen source manifest and elaborated design hash, require tool-derived elaboration/netlist hierarchy and positive sequential/combinational cell census per required operator, require mapped standard-cell references, and reconcile those counts with DC/Formality/VCS reports.

findings.title: SAIF annotation coverage is self-reported rather than derived
findings.evidence: The accepted SAIF has one TC entry, while production_proof claims 99/100 annotated nets and 198/200 pins. No report_activity or list-not-annotated artifact supplies those counts.
findings.impact: A header-scale SAIF can be presented as >=95% full-design activity and support false PTPX power.
findings.required_repair: Require and parse a rooted PrimeTime PX annotation report, derive total/annotated net and pin counts from the mapped design, bind the report to the exact SAIF/netlist/top, and reject one-net or hierarchy-incomplete SAIF.

findings.title: The 17-macro PTPX census and DC macro-inclusion equation are JSON assertions
findings.evidence: The accepted PTPX report contains none of the 17 exact instance names and the DC area report contains no logic/macro split. Both censuses and the split are supplied only by production_proof JSON arithmetic.
findings.impact: Macro presence, SRAM power, and no-double-count total area are not established by Synopsys outputs.
findings.required_repair: Parse rooted link/hierarchy/reference reports for the exact 8+8+1 instances, require per-reference or per-instance PTPX memory power, require DC hierarchical/reference area with explicit macro inclusion, and reconcile all three tool-derived censuses before computing total area/power.

findings.title: Author positive fixture does not exercise the builder's mandatory M527 row identity
findings.evidence: The author R9Fixture retains configuration_id=dense96_fixed_t10, while the builder requires b0_dense96_fixed_t10. M695 had to change the identity before generation to execute the actual production-map attack.
findings.impact: 10/10 author tests cover extractor grammar but miss the future registry-ingress positive path.
findings.required_repair: Add a mandatory-row positive grammar test that reaches validated_production_run_count=1, mark it synthetic, and prove the production config rejects it unless an independent native-run authority is present.
